about.text: Half {{developer}}, half {{video editor}}, fully obsessed with making things people enjoy using and watching. I build the systems behind websites and cut edits that have reached millions of views.

numbers.note: Every figure here must be traceable to something else on this site. Shipped projects counts MSC NU Laguna, Document Tracking & Analytics, Goodness Gracious, Zero to Deploy and Nexus Pass — this portfolio itself is deliberately not counted. Years creating is 2026 minus 2022; bump it each January.

items.summary: Independent short-form editing practice. Film, music and trend-led edits across TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook, with 70M+ documented organic views.
Plan, schedule, and deliver multimedia content for university events while keeping production files organized for smooth team collaboration.
Architected and shipped the backend for the MSC NU Laguna web platform. Live production deployment, launched at SparkPoint 2026.

Led requirements gathering, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and development planning for a PHP and MySQL document tracking system, translating government workflow requirements into system features and development priorities.

items.title: Systems & Backend
items.text: APIs, databases and the connections between systems. I led backend work on a live community website and built REST endpoints that pass EDI transactions between independent systems.
